properties.description: tools/test_reflow2_check.py ItemLayoutGate on the real binary in a real git repo: a committed layout passes and says its hash is computed on read; a tampered item fails INTEGRITY by name; a registered file changed on a branch with no acceptance fails DRIFT; an acceptance matching the file passes (and the Artifact node in the layout carries no checksum), one that no longer matches fails; on the default branch a squashed change is judged by coverage and an unaccepted commit fails.
properties.findings: 2026-10-03 (chg:the-design-is-saved-one-file-per-item-2026-10-03): 5 of 5 ItemLayoutGate tests pass; the whole suite 53 of 53.
